name: Nanase Kira
source:
Daughter of [url=/c19595]Nanase Rin[/url] from Milkyway 2 (formerly [url=/c20235]Yuuki Rin[/url] in Milkyway) and [url=/c19594]Nanase Kenji[/url].

Rin's younger sister [url=/c26034]Yuuki Ran[/url] is her aunt, and Ran's adopted daughter [url=/c20364]Yuuki Setsuka[/url] is her adoptive cousin.

She is the half-sister of [url=/c26058]Kudou Yuuri[/url] who Kenji fathered with a different mother.
